messages:
nora: FYI were targeting tonight's change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Cross-service touchpoints: API route toggle, router header-split, runtime kernel bump + cache priming. Need single decision owner and explicit cache/pin steps. Keep thread terse.

deploybot: Change window created: 2026-03-23T23:00Z->2026-03-24T01:00Z. Requested locks: api, router, runtime. Default canary tooling available. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/change-window

cheng: Runtime detail: v3.3.0 includes scheduler improvement + quantized matmul. Can we do a 3-stage canary: 1%/5%/20% (10m each for first two, 15m final)? Key metrics: p95 latency, tail token latency, error-rate, and token/sec. If p95 increases >180ms OR error-rate >2% OR token/sec drops >12% at any stage -> abort. Note: cache priming required since KV prefixes will be evicted at shift.

rafa: Router: header-split work requires header flag flip + new route table. We prefer router pinned at T0. If runtime not pinned, we will not apply header split. Console team asked for >10m stable post-final-stage before UI flip.

nora: API: we'll stage api-v2.6.2 but hold traffic until router pin confirmed. If router remains unpinned at T0 we keep api on api-v2.5.10. Release notes draft: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-change-draft.md (add cache priming notes).

nora: Minimum checklist:
- T-45m: prime caches or enable read-through fallback for 60m
- T-10m: confirm pins are uploaded to artifacts registry
- T0: pin router + runtime, start 3-stage canary (1%/5%/20%)
- T+35m: evaluation by @cheng (decision owner)
- T+45m: console flip (only if stable 10m after final stage)
- Abort: immediate rollback to router-v2.5.11 and runtime-v3.2.9 (commands below)

cheng: Commands I'll run on go-ahead:
```
# pin artifacts
deployctl pin router=router-v2.7.0 runtime=runtime-v3.3.0
# staged canary
deployctl canary --service router --stages "1%:10m,5%:10m,20%:15m" --notify #incidents
```

ops-bot: Alerting update: notify = #incidents, #eng-oncall. SLO guards set: p95 delta >180ms OR error-rate >2% OR token/sec -12% => auto-alert + page. Auto-failover target configured: router-v2.5.11.

nora: Infra note: please set cache-priming job to run at T-40m and verify TTLs <2h or enable read-through for 60m post-shift. Otherwise we will see mixed prefix fingerprints.

release-bot: Stub created for release notes. Suggested copy: "kernel bump (quantized kernels + scheduler); staged router header-split; cache priming required; console UI gated on runtime/router stability."

rafa: Console owner here. Will not flip UI until I post "console: ready" in this thread. I need a 10m stable window after the final canary stage. If @cheng calls abort I will hold flip and revert any client-side toggles.

cheng: Rollback procedure (if triggers):
```
# rollback router and runtime
deployctl rollback router --to router-v2.5.11
deployctl rollback runtime --to runtime-v3.2.9
# reopen api pin to api-v2.5.10 until we confirm
```

oncall: I'll be monitoring dashboards from T0 and standing by to page. If SLO guard trips, I'll escalate immediately.

nora: Decision ownership recap: @cheng will call go/no-go at evaluation points. If abort, @cheng executes rollback and pings #incidents + @oncall. All teams react :thumbsup: when ready or post brief reason if not. Reconvene +15m before window for final sign-off.

(End of thread)
